title: Boot to navigable TV Shell
objective: Boot a minimal Debian amd64 image into the remote-first GTK3 shell with stable input and measured idle behavior.
constraints: Debian stock kernel/firmware; no custom drivers.
No media applications beyond fixtures required to validate shell navigation.
Resource budgets are gates only after first hardware baseline; proposed values are not assumed measurements.
acceptance: Clean image boots through systemd into the dedicated user session without a conventional desktop environment.
Xorg + Matchbox + GTK3 shell render Home at 720p and 1080p.
Arrow/D-pad, Enter/OK, Back and Home actions navigate every P01 screen without mouse dependency.
Focus never becomes trapped or invisible.
Cold boot, shell startup, idle PSS and D-pad p95 are measured on the reference low-end machine and stored as evidence.
Failure to start the shell produces a recoverable path rather than a blank loop.

history.reason: Documentation baseline completed; implementation may begin.
